newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street shares seen mixed to firmer at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street shares seen mixed to firmer at open.

text.p: Wall Street shares are expected to be mixed to slightly firmer at the open on Thursday, with thefocus returning to earnings after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.
Greenspan's testimony lifted stocks and bonds in the past two days by painting an upbeat picture of the U.S. economy and assuaging fears of an imminent interest rate hike.
The Fed's message, coupled with a steady stream of solid corporate results, should underpin stocks again on Thursday, but profit-taking could hamper gains, analysts said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed up 26.71 points at 8,088.36 on Wednesday.
